name: confighub-skills
description: ConfigHub-native skills for operating Kubernetes with ConfigHub as the source of truth and OCI / ConfigHub Targets for delivery (publish to ConfigHub's OCI registry for ArgoCD or Flux to pull). Covers orientation + config-as-data doctrine, authoring K8s resources and app config, query, bulk mutation, validation triggers, server/external workers, target binding, apply, verification, onboarding imports (Helm / Kustomize), promotion + variants, rollback, and incident triage.
